name: Parergon Technology
summary: Melbourne ISP (Parergon Technology Pty Ltd, ACN 065 972 107, c. 1996-97) under business names Sprint Online / sprint.net.au, plus internet cafe 'The Cafe at the End of the Internet'. Sprint Online became a division of Labyrinth Connections (by Feb 2000); the company later inherited the 'Labyrinth Connections Pty Ltd' corporate name (21 Oct 2002).

events.details: Sprint Online became a division of Labyrinth Connections; sprint.net.au styled itself 'a division of Labyrinth Connections' by Feb 2000, and Labyrinth's About Us page lists Sprint Online among its recent takeovers.

events.details: Corporate name changed to 'Labyrinth Connections Pty Ltd' on 21 Oct 2002 (ACN 065 972 107; ABN 58 065 972 107) - the Labyrinth group's Sprint subsidiary inherited the corporate name when the Labyrinth ISP (ACN 069 211 678) was renamed Key Point Pty Ltd. ABN cancelled 30 Jun 2005.
